text:
Priya: Heads-up — HorizonTech put their POC payment on pause. Procurement says they won't proceed until we're in their vendor portal and the marketplace contract reflects their SOC2 + EU data residency clause.
Sam: Do they mean an actual vendor portal listing or just signed contract uploaded to their SSO procurement system?
Priya: Vendor portal listing + contract acceptance flow. They want a PO creation from the portal.
Raj: That's unusual but doable. Who from Legal can own the portal onboarding?
Nadia: Legal can own the contract signoff but onboarding to their marketplace requires finance team to accept T&Cs in portal. LegalBot: FYI — standard marketplace clause check: IP assignment ok, data residency requested is non-standard for hosted accounts.
Arjun: Technical note: EU-only region is supported for Redwood Private and Dedicated. For hosted, we can route to EU region but customer's KMS for logs isn't currently supported for hosted metrics/logs.
Sam: HorizonTech's security team explicitly called out "customer-managed KMS for audit logs" in their questionnaire. That's a hard blocker for them.
Priya: They also asked for a firm pilot price (flat) and a 30-day SLA. Procurement won't start PO until both price and portal are sorted.
Raj: Commercially we can offer a one-month flat pilot fee. I'll need numbers from Finance. Nadia, can Legal sign the marketplace contract with the data residency redline?
Nadia: We can propose a redline: commit to EU-only storage for customer data and a contractual right to audit. Customer-managed KMS for logs — propose ETA: feasibility study, but can't promise in contract without engineering signoff.
Arjun: Confirmed. If we commit, engineering needs 2-3 weeks for a BYO-KMS pipeline for logs + security review. That's a project, not a quick toggle.
Priya: Ok. I'll tell HorizonTech we can do EU-only and pursue a KMS export plan, but it will impact start date.
Sam: Finance — can you give a pilot flat fee today? We need a number to unblock procurement.
LegalBot: New doc uploaded to /contracts/horizontech/redlines: marketplace-redline-draft.docx
Raj: Finance replied in DM: suggest $12k flat for 30-day pilot given expected usage. Not blocking but needs CRO approval for exceptions.
Nadia: I'll draft email back to procurement: accept marketplace flow conditionally, include EU-only clause, propose technical annex: "KMS export plan to be executed within 21 days of pilot start". Leave placeholder for CRO approval on the fee.
Arjun: If they insist KMS must be in place before pilot start, timeline slides to 3 weeks. If they accept conditional milestone, we can start sooner with reduced logging surface.
Priya: Customer success — can we scope a smaller acceptance criteria set to begin without full logs?
Sam: CS says yes: acceptance can focus on model quality & throughput; full observability can be staged.
Raj: I'll join an exec-to-exec call if we can get a procurement calendar slot. Priya, set up a 30-min call. Include CRO and Head of Legal.
Priya: Scheduling now — propose tomorrow 3pm CET or Friday 9am PST.
Arjun: Engineering will prepare a short feasibility note + risk register by EOD.
Nadia: I'll push the redline doc and comment where we need the KMS language to be conditional.
infra-bot: New ticket created: INF-4821 — "HorizonTech BYO-KMS for logs: feasibility + timeline" (assignee: Arjun)
Sam: Great. Summary of actions: 1) Priya: schedule exec call; 2) Nadia: redline + conditional language; 3) Arjun: feasibility + ETA (INF-4821); 4) Finance/Raj: pilot fee approval; 5) CS: agree reduced acceptance criteria.
Priya: I'll update HorizonTech's procurement contact after exec sync. Thanks team. :pray:
Raj: Quick note — if portal onboarding is a blocker company-wide, we should have a playbook. Filing follow-up item after this POC.
Priya: Noted. Will add to backlog.
Priya: (later) Exec call confirmed for tomorrow 15:00 CET. Agenda and dial-in sent.
Sam: Thanks — keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
